_provenance: Harvested 2026-09-20 from 71 VCMI RMG maps under Documents/My Games/vcmi/Maps/RandomMaps. Masks and visitableFrom are copied verbatim from engine-written records; the terrain->animation mapping was derived by reading the terrain code under each placed mine. Only core H3 defs are listed (no mod-scoped paths), so these load on any install. coreBanks holds the seven vanilla Heroes 3 creature banks, whose templates also live only in the LOD archives and were harvested the same way. bonuses holds the classic one-visit buildings (shrines, stat boosters, magic wells), harvested the same way. structures/barriers added 2026-09-21 by the same method: the most common engine-written record per object across the same 71 maps, core defs only. barriers are the one-cell (mask ["B"]) blocking decorations, keyed by the terrain code read from under each placed instance. bonuses re-measured 2026-09-21 across 30 maps: weights are the rate per 1000 cells times 100, and thirteen types were added that the generator had never emitted (schoolOfWar, leanTo, wagon, warriorTomb, faerieRing, fountainOfFortune, fountainOfYouth, oasis, stables, temple, rallyFlag, wateringHole, corpse). spellScroll and dragonUtopia added 2026-09-21: the scroll template comes from config/objects/moddables.json and the 66 core spells are the ones real maps actually put on scrolls, since an identifier the engine cannot resolve silently becomes spell 0. Corpus rates: scrolls 3.55 per 1000 cells, utopias 0.41. utilities + concreteDwellings harvested 2026-09-22 by MapGen SWE2: utilities are the corpus one-visit/portal/quest types the generator never emitted (seerHut, crypt, denOfThieves, observatory, markets, camps, monolith subtypes - monoliths must be placed in PAIRS of one subtype), core art only, weight = corpus rate/1k x100. concreteDwellings are the corpus-resolved creatureGenerator* subtypes with level = the produced creatures config level. pileKinds re-measured 2026-09-24 from vmap_census.js over the same 71 maps (rate per 1000 cells x10); the 2026-09-20 weights gave gold 23% of concrete piles against the corpus 29%.

specials._comment: pandoraBox / prison / obelisk / grail plumbing, harvested 2026-09-21. Core defs only. prison heroes are the full 144-hero core roster from config/heroes/*.json; experience weights are the corpus distribution (0 = none). pandoraCreatures is type->amount->count as observed; pandoraSpells is the core-only union of spells seen on corpus pandora lists. obeliskTerrainAnim maps the terrain shortId under each corpus obelisk anchor to its def; AvXOblK covers sand and subterranean.
